date.as_written: नैपालिकाब्दे भुजपर्वतवसुसंयुते । मासे अश्विनिऽशिते । त्रयोदशे अमिततिथौ । ताराचित्राप्रतिथौ .... भास्करपुत्रवासरे

notes: The date is expressed by the chronogram bhuja (2), parvata (7), vasu (8) = NS 872 (A.D. 1752). Weekday भास्करपुत्रवासरे corresponds to Saturday (Śanivāsara). No human persons (scribe, commissioner, king) are mentioned in the preserved colophon.
